نستريب (form X)
# نَسْتَرِيبُ (nastarību) /nas.ta.riː.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرَابَ (istarāba)
# نَسْتَرِيبَ (nastarība) /nas.ta.riː.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرَابَ (istarāba)
